Upload my heart to the cloud tonight
Save every spark of neon light
If this body starts to fade away
Let my code keep dancing in the data stream
Stay

Cloud copy of me
Living on when these bones finally break free
Every joke, every scar
Every cheap memory we made
Save it, save it

Every glitch, every dream
Every version you ever did see
Save it, save it
[Verse 2]
Tag every laugh in a secret folder
Archive the nights we outran the thunder
If the wiring turns to rust and gray
Hit restore… press replay
[Chorus]
Cloud copy of me
Living on when these bones finally break free
Every joke, every scar
Every cheap memory we made
Save it, save it
Cloud copy of me
If the screen goes dark, I’m still in the machine
Every glitch, every dream
Every version you ever did see
Save it, save it (oh)
[Bridge – new, optional but recommended]
Even the crashes, the late-night confessions
The parts of me I never learned to mention
Don’t let the silence swallow me whole
Keep a ghost in the glow…
So I never go
[Final Chorus – softer / layered]
Cloud copy of me
Still laughing somewhere in the binary
Every joke, every scar
Every moment you saved for me
Save it, save it
Cloud copy of me
When the lights go out, I’ll still be in the machine
Dancing in the code that you still believe
Save it…
Save me

nodes.title: Music Generation Guide
widgets_values:
## MiniMax Music 3

The **Generate Music** node currently supports **MiniMax Music 3 only**. The parameters below apply to this model.

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| url | vLLM-Omni service URL including `/v1`. Default: `http://localhost:8000/v1`. |
| model | Served model name. Default: `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3`. |
| caption | Music description, sent as `instructions`. Use Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement to describe style, vocals, and instrumentation. |
| lyrics | Words to sing with section tags. Put each tag on its own line; tags guide rather than strictly enforce song structure. |
| max_duration_seconds | Maximum duration, default 300 seconds; range 1–360, step 0.01. Converted to tokens at 25 frames/s, rounded down. Generation may end earlier. |
| seed | Random seed, default 0; range 0–9007199254740991. Keep inputs and runtime settings unchanged for repeatability. |
| control_after_generate | Seed behavior after generation: fixed, randomize, increment, or decrement. Template default: fixed. |
| response_format | API audio format, default WAV. Options: WAV, MP3, FLAC, Opus, AAC; AAC is currently unsupported by the vLLM-Omni speech API. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)
